svg.title: Instacart catalog current state, ownership swimlanes
svg.desc: One horizontal band per team; sources on the left feed the band that uses them; consumers on the right share one bus.
svg.text: Instacart catalog today: who owns which step
One band per team. Data moves left to right; a vertical arrow is a handoff between teams. Grey lines with no arrowhead mean runs on or calls. Dashed boxes are unconfirmed and
out of PARSE: pick inputs, test
WHAT HURTS TODAY, PER THE INTERVIEWS (PARAPHRASED)
No single list of attribute definitions
Definitions moved around as teams shipped fast (Brittany)
Attribute model built for PDP badges
Agentic shopping needs attributes to mean more (Brittany)
It differs by attribute and by retailer contract (Peggy)
No semantic layer for downstream teams
They cannot tell a field's quality or freshness (Peggy)
Stream and batch are being merged
Latency, plus ten years of legacy code (Sonali)
Allergen and compliance tags are trust busters (Tarang)
Confirmed by: Tarang Mittal (Director of Engineering, Catalog Content) 10-26; Peggy Men (Catalog Ops) 10-23; Brittany Drager (GPM, Catalog) 10-22 and 10-26; Sonali Parthasarathy (former
catalog SDM) 10-22; docs.instacart.com; Instacart engineering posts (PARSE, Maple, Semantic IDs); Instacart job postings. Dashed boxes are not confirmed by any of these.
